newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka John up 1.9 pct on foreign buy.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka John up 1.9 pct on foreign buy.

text.p: Shares of John Keells Holdings Ltd rose 1.9 percent, or three rupees, to 160 rupees in early Tuesday trading on foreign buying, brokers said.
John Keells shares are relatively cheap at current prices when compared with two years ago, brokers said.
"The share was above 400 rupees in the first quarter of 1994 when the market peaked. Some investors find the current price a bargain," a broker at CDIC Sassoon Cumberbatch Strockbrokers said.
There was a block deal of 7,100 John Keells shares at 160 rupees, brokers said.
John Keells is the holding company of a diversified group with over 50 subsidiaries.
